topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: I stepped outside the café, the air suddenly cooler. The sign, hanging a little lopsided, announced what I already felt deep down. "Thank you for the years of memories. Our last day is this Sunday." The paper was thin under my fingers, the words blurring as I traced them. The hum of the city, usually a comforting backdrop, seemed to fade, leaving me with the echo of this place, its walls once warm with the laughter of strangers. I remember the corner seat by the window, the way the light would catch the edges of the table, making everything shine. Now, the thought of this space becoming something else, a different story for someone else, feels like a chapter torn from a book, incomplete, longing for what was.
